title: Check my vibe coded game: Beatgard
author: GlumAdvantage7889
selftext:
Basically you hit the drums and your viking army gets stronger and defeats the enemy. I got some assets from itchio, generated songs with Suno and used some STEMs splitter to separate the instruments so that Claude could map the tiles. I’m still improving the performance for sea and boss battles, because there are more effects and particles. 

App Store link: [https://apps.apple.com/br/app/beatgard-viking-war-drums/id6819034737](https://apps.apple.com/br/app/beatgard-viking-war-drums/id6819034737)

comments.author: Xinnobun
comments.body: Fun idea. What would make it even more entertaining is by giving your army stats and each stage affects the strength of your army. So if you do poorly in a fight, you'll lose more men and start the next battle handicapped. But if you do well, your army continues to grow stronger, can handle more errors without faltering, etc.

replies.author: GlumAdvantage7889
replies.body: Good idea, maybe I’ll do that in future updates
